summary.text: Lauren Simmons is a Democratic state representative who has represented Texas House District 146 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as a community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Lauren Ashley Simmons was born in Houston, Texas, and her career experience includes working as a community advocate.
Simmons succeeded Shawn Thierry in representing District 146 and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Alexandria Butler is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
